fields.statement: At 88cc562d: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(daemon-load-settings|describe-golden|daemon-settings|daemon-settings-scope|daemon-load-hold|daemon-load-status) passes (describe-golden matches the regenerated max_load/min_memory fields and the daemon.set key list). By hand with a scratch build in a fresh root + project: rhiza daemon settings --json lists rhiza.daemon.maxLoad default 3.0 and rhiza.daemon.minMemory default 2G (machine scope); daemon set maxLoad 2.5 and minMemory 4G write them to the root rhiza.toml [daemon]; daemon set maxLoad -- -1, maxLoad busy, minMemory lots and minMemory 4Q each exit 2 with a validation message and cmp shows rhiza.toml unchanged; maxLoad 0 and minMemory 0 are accepted. Diff read: DaemonRequest gains MaxLoad/MinMemory (--max-load/--min-memory), validated in daemonConfOf with Usagef, settingDefs map the flags. Scoped internal/api tests (TestDaemon|TestSettingDefsDescribed|Usage|Hold|Load) all PASS; the package's post-run guard flagged ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json changed, which is the live root daemon on the VM, not this diff.
